articles.title: Carney secures majority government with sweep of 3 byelections
Carney clinches a majority government with 3 Liberal byelection wins
articles.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney clinched a majority government Monday after three byelection wins in central Canada, a significant result that will give the governing party full control of the House of Commons and possibly three more years in power.

articles.title: Mark Carney enters his majority era
